title: Ku-PLS code supplement: replication packages and Lean proofs for two papers on functional partial least squares
description:
Code supplement for two papers on functional partial least squares under heavy-tailed predictors.

  • two-moments/: Python replication package for Specification Testing in Functional Linear Regression with Heavy-Tailed Predictors: Reweighted Partial Least Squares (earlier versions: Functional Partial Least Squares under Two Moments). Every simulation, both applications, the checks behind each claim, the stored output of every run and the cached FRED panels; the README maps each table to its script.
  • replication/: Python replication for Moment-Free Inference for Functional Partial Least Squares.
  • KuPLS/: Lean 4 / Mathlib development certifying the deterministic algebraic facts both papers rely on.

Requirements: numpy and scipy for the Python packages; elan/lake for the Lean development.
